result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: no more than once per 12 months, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours audits through an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, Vendor-funded unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct or remote access to Customer systems. The usage-verification scope and non-disruption requirement are limited, reasonable protections that do not disturb unrelated commercial intent. The drafting is clear and consistent with the existing restrictions in Section 22.2.
